profile.name: Olivia Grant
profile.summary: NASM-certified personal trainer with 5 years in luxury clubs in Manhattan. Builds personalized strength and mobility programs for in-person and virtual clients.

descriptions: Grew an active client base from 12 to 38 clients, selling $14K in personal training packages per month
Run fitness assessments and movement screens for every new member intro session
Design and coach personalized programs for 30 in-person and 8 virtual clients
Manage my calendar of 40+ weekly sessions in Mindbody with no double bookings
Complete 20+ CEUs a year through workshops on mobility and pre/postnatal training
Keep the fitness floor organized and safe during shifts
Greeted members and handled service requests on the gym floor, keeping a 4.9/5 member experience rating
